content: Who are you?
Hi, Dad. I'm Choi, your son.
Where are we now?
We're at home, Dad. Everything is okay.
I'm a bit tired now!
I'm sorry to hear that, Dad. Rest up and take it easy, okay?
Okay, thanks son!
You're welcome, Dad. I'm here if you need anything.
Oh, son! Do you remember where I was born?
Yes, Dad, you were born in the United States. You used to tell me stories about your life there.
Then where did I first meet your mother?
You met Mom in Korea after you moved there for work. It's a wonderful story!
Oh, what are you doing for a living now?
I'm a researcher and a neurologist, Dad. I study the brain, especially focusing on Alzheimer's disease.
Oh sorry son! I'm so easy to forget things these days.
It's okay, Dad. No need to apologize. I'm always here to help remind you.
Do you want to eat something outside tonight with me?
That sounds great, Dad. Let's do it!
What shall we eat son?
How about trying some Korean barbecue? It's always a treat.
Barbecue? Hmmm, that sounds delicious!
It sure is, Dad! We'll have a great time.
Okay, so do you know any famous restaurants near here?
Yes, Dad. There's a great Korean barbecue place not too far from here. You'll love it.
Wait, I think I know this place. Do you want to try King BBQ restaurant?
That sounds perfect, Dad. King BBQ it is!
King BBQ restaurant is more like a buffet than a traditional Korean BBQ restaurant.
That's fine, Dad. We can enjoy a buffet tonight. It'll be fun trying a bit of everything!
Then, do you want to do something else after that?
Sure, Dad. We can take a walk or have some dessert afterward. Whatever you prefer.
Hmm, do you want to watch a movie? I heard that there is a new movie called 'Love from first sight' that is a really good. Do you want to watch it with me?
That sounds like a great idea, Dad. I'd love to watch 'Love from First Sight' with you. Let's enjoy it together after dinner.
Then, we will eat at King BBQ restaurant at 6 pm and watch movie 'Love from first sight' at 8 pm. What do you think?
That sounds like a perfect plan, Dad. I'm looking forward to it.
Yeah, me too. I'm so excited for this night!
Me too, Dad. It's going to be a wonderful evening together.
Okay, then I will go get ready. See you later.
Great, Dad. See you soon.
By the way, do you know where mom is?
I believe she's in the living room, Dad. You might find her there.
Oh. I'm just thinking maybe tonight will only be the two of us. You know just like the old days.
That sounds lovely, Dad. Just the two of us, like the old days.
Okay, thanks son! You know I love you so much!
I love you too, Dad. More than words can say.
